scope_differences: Evidence content is delivered only as an application-mediated attachment download; no inline viewer is designed because the accepted EvidenceContentDownload is an attachment with Cache-Control: no-store.
Case access-grant listing and revocation (UX-ACCESS-GRANTS) are included under Content permission because they are the only accepted way to see and withdraw content permission.
Assignment target and ETag discovery for administrators has no accepted API capability; the assignment command is designed, discovery is an owned deferred decision.

supporting_operations.use: viewer_access.relationship and viewer_access.can_view_evidence_content establish the caller's own case relationship and content permission before any content control is offered
result_digest of the exact result being adjudicated (AdjudicationCreateRequest.adjudicated_result_digest)
roles of the signed-in principal for navigation only; never an authorization decision

recovery_vocabulary.meaning: Repeat the same read, or resend the same command with the same idempotency key.
Repeat later, honouring any returned Retry-After; no countdown is invented.
The same command is still being processed; wait and resend it unchanged with the same key.
Read the authoritative Evaluation state before choosing a presentation.
Correct the request before any new attempt; field values are not echoed.
Reload the current state and its ETag, show what changed, and let the person decide again; never overwrite silently.
The key was used for a different command; review the intended action and submit it as a new command.
Do not retry; show the governed state only.

error_presentation.alternate_condition: Only on getEvidenceContent, and only when getCase viewer_access already establishes a visible case with can_view_evidence_content=false; otherwise ACCESS_DENIED

pre_access_notice.text: Downloading the original evidence is recorded in the audit log.

content_actions.DOWNLOAD_OFFERED: An explicit download control is offered after the audit notice; the backend still decides.
content_actions.CONTENT_PERMISSION_REQUIRED: The case is visible but content permission was not granted; no download control and no request.
content_actions.NOT_VISIBLE: The case is not visible to this person; existence is not disclosed.
content_actions.NOT_OFFERED: This role has no evidence surface.
content_actions.BREAK_GLASS_ONLY: No content by role; content is reachable only through the caller's own active, scoped break-glass grant covering the item.

open_decisions.decision: Administrator assignment target and If-Match acquisition: no administrator queue-read or principal-directory capability exists, so the assignment command can only act on a review item reference, ETag and analyst identifier supplied through an accepted channel
open_decisions.owner: API owner (governed API revision), carried from UX-001

open_decisions.decision: A CASE_EVIDENCE break-glass grant has no accepted evidence-listing operation for administrators (listEvidence and getCase are USER/ANALYST only); evidence identifiers are reachable only from content-free audit metadata
No operation lists break-glass grants awaiting review; reviewers find grants through listAuditEvents (BREAK_GLASS_ACTIVATED) and then getBreakGlassGrant
reason_code on assignment and access-grant revocation has no governed vocabulary
Principals appear as opaque identifiers; no principal display-name capability exists for queues, grants or audit
open_decisions.owner: API owner with Product / Security UX

open_decisions.decision: An assigned analyst without permits_evidence_content may author a C4 rationale that the same analyst cannot read back; confirm the intended authoring rule
Break-glass duration is server-set and NOT YET SPECIFIED; the UX shows only the server's expires_at

non_goals: No frontend, API or runtime implementation.
No new API operation, persisted field, permission grant, role or retention rule.
No inline evidence viewer, preview or thumbnail.

review_findings.summary: Break-glass evidence access was not caller-bound: a different administrator inherited the grantee's authorization in the decision procedure
Security-sensitive display copy was not bound to governed meaning: existence disclosure, leaked rationale detail and adjudication-replaces-result wording passed
A contradictory second security matrix could coexist with the accepted projection in UX-004
APPROVED or CLOSED was accepted with claims.independently_reviewed = false

Re-raised MEDIUM-1: an accessible announcement for a masked (not found or not visible) resource could carry adjudication outcome and time; announcement fields were checked only against a global allowlist
Re-raised MEDIUM-2: a contradictory security table written without outer pipes (valid GFM) evaded the projection-integrity check
Re-raised MEDIUM-2: the projection-integrity check rejected harmless explanatory tables that merely mentioned a role name such as ADMINISTRATOR
